edges.history_summary: Married 36 years. Adaeze is the emotional centre; Emeka the practical anchor. They rarely conflict in the group chat but their different communication styles are visible.
shared_events: raising four children in the UK

edges.history_summary: Tolu is the eldest and the one Adaeze leans on most. She is proud of him but sometimes treats him as a co-parent rather than a child.
Initially cautious — Adaeze worried Funke would westernise the family's culture. Their relationship warmed significantly after a private cooking session where Adaeze taught Funke to make egusi soup.
Closest relationship in the family. Seun pushes back on traditions but they communicate openly. Their flashpoint has been Seun's veganism which Adaeze initially took as a rejection of her cooking.
shared_events: Adaeze learning to adapt jollof rice for vegans

edges.history_summary: Adaeze is more lenient with Kayode than with her other children — 'my soft one'. She notices when he's absent more quickly than anyone else.
Adaeze is protective and occasionally exasperated by Bisi's deferments. She worries quietly about Bisi's future but never pushes hard in the group chat.
Adaeze and Dele grew up together in Lagos. They have a warm, bantering relationship. Dele tends to side with Emeka on most family decisions.
shared_events: their mother's passing three years ago

edges.history_summary: Emeka and Dele are the most similar people in the family — both formal, both traditional, both quietly proud. They communicate almost exclusively in person or on the phone; they use the family chat mainly to read, not to post.
Tolu and Seun argue about ideas — he finds her lifestyle choices preachy; she finds his solutions-first approach dismissive. They respect each other but rarely agree.
shared_events: Seun challenging Tolu's medical opinion about nutrition

edges.history_summary: Tolu and Kayode are cordial but not close. Their shared language is football. Tolu occasionally gives Kayode career advice that Kayode doesn't ask for.
Seun and Kayode are the closest sibling pair. They have a private shorthand the rest of the family doesn't always follow. Seun was the one who told Kayode to be more present for Nkem.
shared_events: Seun's health crisis that started her wellness journey

edges.history_summary: Seun and Bisi are six years apart but very close. Seun is the one Bisi calls when she's struggling. It was Seun who Bisi told first about her plan to finally sit her exams.
shared_events: Seun converting Bisi to vegan snacks

edges.history_summary: 18 months together. Kayode is more public about affection in the family chat than Nkem. Nkem's integration into the group has been gradual and largely successful.
shared_events: Kayode's promotion announcement with Nkem present
Seun formally welcoming Nkem to 'the family WhatsApp'

edges.history_summary: Closest in age and temperament of the Oyelaran children. Kayode is the one who had the conversation with Bisi that convinced her to commit to her exams.
shared_events: their late-night call about Bisi's exams
defending each other from family pressure
